subject.title: Stuck-session liveness monitor misclassifies healthy processing runs as stale during event-loop stalls

question: Should this narrow event-loop-stall false-abort report remain open as linked verification until the run-lifecycle integration PR lands, or be folded into the broader run-lifecycle umbrella now?
rationale: Current source supports the risk, but changing recovery semantics affects established stale-processing recovery tests and the candidate fix is part of a broader compatibility-sensitive liveness stack.

options.title: Keep Linked Until Integration Lands
options.body: Leave this issue open and use it as a verification target for the open run-lifecycle integration PR, then close it with merged proof.

options.title: Fold Into Umbrella Now
options.body: Close this issue as tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101863 after preserving the report as linked evidence for the broader design.

options.title: Narrow Fix First
options.body: Require a live or deterministic event-loop-stall reproduction and approve a focused classifier/recovery change independent of the integration stack.

recommendation.title: Keep Linked Until Integration Lands
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and use it as a verification target for the open run-lifecycle integration PR, then close it with merged proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the open design and integration PRs that currently carry the proposed liveness policy.
